title: PutResponse
description: What happened to each item of a put.

added.description: Items that were not in the store before.

updated.description: Items that replaced a stored item with the same id.

skipped.description: Items not stored, each with the reason, such as an id deleted earlier, which is never stored again.

items.description: One item that was not stored.

reason.description: Why it was not stored, as a sentence.
